name: Scramble text
summary: Random characters that flicker and settle into the real word left to right, for hacker reveals and data-style titles.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame; overrides at when set

params.name: text
params.note: the word the characters settle into

params.name: size
params.note: font size; shrinks to fit 980 px

params.name: seed
params.note: change to get a different scramble

params.name: color
params.note: final text colour; default style accent

author: krakujs
